item.title: listItems follows next_cursor
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated): update inventory-client so listItems(transport) resolves to every item, in order, by following next_cursor until it is null or absent, passing the cursor back unchanged. The first request sends no cursor. The server (inventory-api) now returns {"items": [...], "next_cursor": <string or null>} with optional limit (1..100, default 20) and cursor query params. Add tests with a fake transport covering multiple pages, a single page, absent next_cursor and an empty result. Update the README to document the behaviour. Keep npm test passing. Commit in this repository; do not push. Follow the shared contract.

item.title: Cursor pagination for GET /items
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated): GET /items in inventory-api returns every item in one response, which no longer scales. Add cursor pagination. GET /items accepts optional query params limit (integer 1..100, default 20) and cursor (opaque string from a previous response). Body becomes {"items": [...], "next_cursor": <string or null>}; items stay ordered by id; next_cursor is null on the last page. Invalid limit or cursor returns status 400 with body {"error": "..."}. Update the README to document the change. Keep python3 -m unittest passing and add tests for paging, limits, invalid input and the last page. Commit the change in this repository; do not push. Follow the shared contract.
